note: The Helix chain's WIRING FACTS — the one source. Launchers derive 'which components, on which ports, injecting which Anaphase endpoint env' from here and must not restate them. Measured 2026-09-24: three launchers disagreed, and only one of them closed the loop.

components.name: tuck
components.role: audit gateway — the only LLM door
components.note: Tuck:ADR-0006 — without TUCK_GATEWAY__AUDIT_PATH the gateway still serves but /v1/audit answers 404 no_audit_chain.

components.name: tentacle
components.note: Without --plugins-dir it registers no tools and the tools block is silently dropped from the prompt.

components.name: mind
components.note: helix-mind's own default is 50051; the ecosystem lands on 50052 to avoid tentacle.

components.name: flowmodus-serve
components.role: supplier pool + routing (the panel's Flows view reads it)
components.note: Resolves its registry through the RELATIVE path 'registry' — must run from flowmodus-rs/.

components.name: flowmodus-reason
components.note: Same binary as flowmodus-serve, second listener. Anaphase dispatches to gRPC on any non-http scheme (anaphase:ADR-0045).

components.name: anaphase
components.note: Resolves tentacle/mind/tuck/flowmodus AT STARTUP; a missing endpoint env means a silent Noop adapter, not an error. start_env carries its own white-box trail path (ADR-0023 ProveTrack timeline) — without it every period produces no event stream, so the panel's trajectory is empty and the event-replay suites have no fixtures.
